Proposed SL2 in earlier records is unapproved. All SL1-4 base requirements/enhancements are inventoried; decide each FR claim.
TLS1.2 is mandatory. TLS1.3 is optional overall. Keep TLS1.3 obligations in the plan if selected. Confirm server/client claims for MMS/104.
Decide mobile code, wireless, passwords, symmetric authentication and optional extensions. N/A requires documented justification and approval.
English PDF38-39 of4-1 are blank. SVV-3/4/5 and independence Table3 recovered from French PDF94-96 in the same supplied file.
7.5.5.2 names status_request_v2 with RFC6066. Table12 identifies RFC6066 status_request mandatory and RFC6961/v2 optional. Implement status_request; resolve wording with lab.
Table1 pairs DHE_RSA_AES256_GCM_SHA384 with0x00A1, but IANA/RFC5288 specify0x009F. Named suite retained with IANA identifier and discrepancy recorded.

CR1.6/1.13/2.4/2.13/3.2/3.10-3.14/5.2/5.3 redirect to type-specific clauses. CR2.3/5.4/7.5 explicitly have no component-level requirement. AnnexesA/B are informative navigational summaries, not additional unconditional obligations.
